nodes.label: manifest.json
nodes.description: Versioned manifest file (schema version 1) in the shared folder, tracks writeInProgress state

nodes.label: sync-conflict files
nodes.description: Files matching .sync-conflict- pattern, reported but never loaded or deleted by SharedDataStore

nodes.label: Archive exchange format
nodes.description: ZIP-based portable archive containing schema-versioned record JSON and hash-addressed photo originals

nodes.label: SharedDataStore status states
nodes.description: State machine with unavailable, unconfigured, ready, migration, problem, and conflict states

nodes.label: Photo externalization
nodes.description: Photos stored as external files at photos/<batch>/<entry>.<extension> with relative photoRef values in shared records

nodes.label: Serialized promise queue writes
nodes.description: Shared writes are serialized through a promise queue, marking writeInProgress in manifest during multi-record writes

nodes.label: Migration choice
nodes.description: When both legacy device data and shared data exist, the store holds the snapshot pending an explicit shared or device decision

nodes.label: Camera process death restoration
nodes.description: Android process death can return a Capacitor appRestoredResult; listenForRestoredCameraPhoto lets App recover the pending photo flow

nodes.label: Reminder reconciliation
nodes.description: Requests permission, cancels previously scheduled notifications, and schedules current due checks; batch state remains authoritative on failure

nodes.label: Atomic writes
nodes.description: Crash-resistant writes using temp file + fsync + rename, sibling backup, recovery of .tmp-/.bak- on next load, 64 MB file cap

nodes.label: Path traversal protection
nodes.description: Rust bridge validates and rejects traversal and absolute paths

nodes.label: Formula engine
nodes.description: Recursive-descent parser avoiding eval, unit-aware

nodes.label: W1: Photo hydration data loss hazard
nodes.description: One unreadable/corrupt photo file voids the entire batch state on load; parseNativeBatchState returns null if any photo fails
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity high, data loss risk

nodes.label: W2: Live dataset tracked in git
nodes.description: The live Syncthing dataset shared/ is tracked in git including .stfolder, .stversions, and migration-backup
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity high, repo hygiene

nodes.label: W4: Documentation contradicts code
nodes.description: docs/android-desktop-implementation-gaps.md says features are absent when they exist since 2026-08-12
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity medium

nodes.label: W5: No CI or lint config
nodes.description: No GitHub Actions, no lint tooling, no enforced typecheck; only local build/test
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity medium

nodes.label: W6: App.tsx monolith
nodes.description: UI is a 1755-line App.tsx with 2836-line styles.css; BatchView rendered twice with duplicated props; persistence calls repeat 5 places
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity medium, fragility

nodes.label: W9: No schema migration framework
nodes.description: schemaVersion !== 1 rejects the whole snapshot; every future schema change is a hard cutover
nodes.rationale: Finding from repo audit: severity low

nodes.label: Recommended fix: photo hydration fail-soft
nodes.description: Per-entry fallback in hydration paths: if photo file missing/corrupt, drop just that entry's photo data instead of nulling the whole state
nodes.rationale: Recommendation A from audit: smallest change at actual trust boundary

nodes.label: Syncthing transport
nodes.description: Peer-to-peer file sync using TLS, no subscription required, preserves conflict copies but does not merge, versioning is not backup

nodes.label: Local SQLite database
nodes.description: Each installation owns a private SQLite database; never sync the live .db file, WAL, or journal

nodes.label: Immutable records
nodes.description: Timeline entries and photos are immutable in v1; corrections create a new record or explicit tombstone

nodes.label: Android scoped storage
nodes.description: Android limits broad shared-storage access; use system file picker and SAF for user-chosen directories

nodes.label: .stfolder marker
nodes.description: Syncthing folder marker that Android cleaning software can remove, stopping sync until restored

nodes.label: Capacitor
nodes.description: Android wrapper with official Camera, Local Notifications, and Filesystem plugins

nodes.label: Tauri 2
nodes.description: Desktop wrapper with filesystem, SQL/SQLite, dialogs, and notification plugins; no portable scheduled-notification API

nodes.label: Vite + React + TypeScript
nodes.description: Web-first UI stack with shared domain/storage/export code; platform capabilities behind small adapters

nodes.label: Nextcloud/WebDAV
nodes.description: Viable only when an always-on existing server is already wanted; requires maintaining server, TLS, upgrades, backups
